args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

round_money claimed to implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
but quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly build to
fail for cases like 2.665, which should round to 2.66 under half-even
but rounded to 2.67 under half-up.

args.body:
## Problem

The nightly build failed in `tests/test_money.py`: `round_money` was expected to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` quantized with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This broke the half-even test case (`2.665` → `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Fix

`src/money.py` now uses `Decimal.quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)`, matching both its docstring and FIN-212.

## Verification

CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`).
